canon.note: Basic Frost Thorn (120901) Ice DMG 50%->140% of ATK (L10 140%). Skill Darting Ironthorn (120902) deals 110%->220% (L10 220%) and activates Soulsteel Sync (CRIT Rate from Talent #1 = 20% L10, CRIT DMG from #2 = 30% L10, 20% Effect RES trace). After any Yanqing attack Talent One With the Sword (120904) rolls a fixed #3 chance (L10 = 60%) for a Follow-Up ATK dealing #4 = 50% (L10) of ATK split across hits, with #6 = 65% base chance to Freeze for 1 turn; Frozen targets take Ice Additional DMG #5 = 50% at the start of their turn. Ultimate Amidst the Raining Bliss (120903) grants CRIT Rate #1 = 60% (plus #2 = 50% extra CRIT DMG while Soulsteel Sync is active, buff 1 turn) then deals #3 = 350% (L10) Ice DMG. A2 Icing on the Kick adds 30% ATK Ice DMG to Ice-weak enemies after Yanqing attacks; A6 Gentle Blade grants SPD +10% for 2 turns on a CRIT Hit. Energy limit 140.

fixtures.env: Yanqing E0 solo vs 3 Ice-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Darting Ironthorn (120902) is Yanqing's damaging Skill action.
Darting Ironthorn hits the primary target 4 times per cast (16 hits over 4 Skill uses in this fixture), carrying the full 120902 multiplier.
Using the Skill activates the Soulsteel Sync effect on Yanqing (120902).
Talent One With the Sword rolls a fixed chance (#3, L10 = 60%) after Yanqing attacks to launch the Soulsteel Sync Follow-Up ATK.
Yanqing's kit exposes Basic ATK, Skill and Ultimate as its action set; it never falls back to a generic attack action.
Darting Ironthorn L10 multiplier is 220% of ATK (120902 #1); the engine delivers it as 4 hits of 55% (0.55) each.
Amidst the Raining Bliss (120903 #3) deals Ice DMG equal to 350% of ATK at L10 in a single hit.
Basic Frost Thorn (120901) runs the 50%->140% ladder (L10 = 140%); at the engine's default Basic Lv6 it totals 100%, delivered as a 50/25/25 split (first hit 0.5).

Soulsteel Sync from the Skill lasts 1 turn (120902). The engine stores self-buffs applied on the caster's own turn as turns=2: the applying turn's own endTick consumes one tick, so the buff is present for exactly that one turn (same encoding as yq_ult_buff_stats).
The Ultimate increases Yanqing's CRIT Rate by #1 = 60% at L10 (120903), buff lasting 1 turn (stored as turns=2).
The Follow-Up ATK deals Ice DMG equal to #4 = 50% of ATK at L10 (120904), split 30/70 → first hit should be 0.15.
Yanqing's Ultimate uses the standard 140-Energy ladder (sp_need 140); over this fixture his action set regenerates exactly 215 Energy.
Soulsteel Sync is applied during the Skill before the A2 Icing on the Kick additional hit resolves.
The Ultimate action starts before Amidst the Raining Bliss damage resolves.
A2 Icing on the Kick: after Yanqing attacks, enemies with Ice Weakness take Ice Additional DMG equal to 30% of Yanqing's ATK.
A6 Gentle Blade: when a CRIT Hit is triggered, Yanqing's SPD increases by 10% for 2 turns.
The Follow-Up's Freeze (#6 = 65% base chance) makes Frozen targets take Ice Additional DMG equal to #5 = 50% of ATK at the start of their turn.
